description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

descriptions.zh:
1. 此API仅支持云原生实例，老架构实例请使用TriggerNetwork方法
2. kibana 规格需大于1核2G
descriptions.en:
1. This API operation is supported only for cloud-native instances. For legacy architecture instances, use the TriggerNetwork method.
2. The Kibana specification must be greater than 1 vCPU and 2 GB of memory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch enable-kibana-pvl-network --instance-id es-cn-n6w1oxxx0000 --client-token xxxxx --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
